title: PDF pages stay blank in the Orca app (placeholder only)
cause: Rendering waited on IntersectionObserver and pdf.js's requestAnimationFrame loop, both paused while Orca's window is hidden or occluded
fix: Visibility computed from scroll offsets; non-rAF render path; harness --no-raf check (fp-media)

title: Formula cells without cached values show '=C2*D2' instead of a result
cause: Files written by scripts (openpyxl) store no cached values; SheetJS CE does not calculate
fix: Safe formula evaluator (no eval) for common operators and functions, with unit tests (fp-office)

title: Body text falls back to a serif font when Office fonts are missing
cause: Documents name Calibri/Cambria/맑은 고딕, which macOS, Linux and phones lack
fix: @font-face local() aliases to metric-compatible or platform fonts (fp-office)

title: Plugin folder exceeded Orca's 50 MiB limit
cause: Orca counts the whole folder: node_modules, Orca child worktrees and evidence screenshots
fix: Shipped plugin moved to plugin/ (manifest, editor, vendor only: about 6 MB)

title: orca plugin test fails: cannot import ./orca-runtime.mjs
cause: Orca's Windows test loader rejects its own runtime when the plugin is on a different drive (D:) than Orca (C:)
fix: verify.mjs runs unit tests from a temporary copy on the system drive

title: txt/csv/tsv/log/html/svg open in Orca's own Source view first
cause: Orca always treats suffixes it opens itself (and text-looking files) as priority 'option'
fix: Documented: switch with the view toggle at the tab's top right; preview editors are registered for these suffixes
